summary.text: Dave Cortese was elected in November 2020 to represent California's 15th Senate District, which encompasses much of Santa Clara County.

paragraphs.text: He previously served on the Santa Clara County Board of Supervisors for over a decade (four years as board president), on the San Jose City Council for eight years, and as a trustee of the East Side Union High School District for eight years. He is also an attorney and business owner.

He grew up in San Jose, graduated from Bellarmine College Preparatory, earned a political science degree from the University of California, Davis, and earned his law degree at Lincoln University Law School in San Jose.
